user.title: Set up AC PID Frequency
user.description: The controller intelligently learns the matching temperature offset to steer the air conditioner to your target frequency. Pick the master indoor unit and compressor frequency entity.

data_description.climate_entity: This entity is read (target temperature, mode) and operated in the card. Its integration must support an external room sensor; enter the generated sensor there afterwards.
data_description.frequency_entity: Entity that reports the current compressor frequency as a number.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Sensor or weather entity for weather-aware learning (cold, moderate, mild).
data_description.room_temp_entity: Real room thermometer for thermal overheat protection. Fallback: current_temperature of the climate entity.
data_description.defrost_entity: Defrost detection. During defrosting the controller pauses the emergency brake and learning. Fallback: hvac_action of the climate entity.
data_description.indoor_units: Optional. Shown small and read-only in the card.

abort.already_configured: An AC PID Frequency controller already exists for this air conditioner.

data_description.climate_entity: Target temperature and mode are read from this entity.
data_description.frequency_entity: Entity that reports the current compressor frequency as a number.
data_description.room_temp_entity: Thermal room limit against unwanted overheating.
data_description.defrost_entity: Pauses regulation and emergency brake during defrost cycles.
data_description.indoor_units: Optional. Display only in the card.

tuning.title: Control and learning parameters
tuning.description: Adjust dead times, safety limits and overheat protection.

data_description.interval_s: Seconds between two controller calculation steps.
data_description.reaction_time_s: Minimum observation time (e.g. 120 s) after a step to give the sluggish AC time to react.
data_description.deadband_hz: Dead band around target (Hz) in which the state is held and learned.
data_description.max_offset: Maximum offset in Kelvin relative to target temperature.
data_description.max_room_overheat: If the real room exceeds target by more than this value, thermal throttling activates.
data_description.offset_brake: Offset added when frequency exceeds emergency brake.
data_description.fault_timeout_min: If input data is missing longer than this time, the sensor becomes unavailable.
